codes.title: Values
codes.description: One barcode per line: product numbers, SKUs, serials, ISBNs… Via the API you can also pass objects {"text": "…", "type": "code39", "name": "file-name"}.

type.title: Barcode type
type.description: Symbology. Auto picks EAN-13 for 13 digits, UPC-A for 12, EAN-8 for 8, ITF-14 for 14 and Code 128 for anything else.

format.title: File format
format.description: PNG for labels and documents, SVG for print and design tools.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Pixels per bar module in the PNG. 3 is good for screens, 5+ for printing.

heightMm.title: Bar height (mm)
heightMm.description: Height of linear barcodes. Ignored for 2D codes (Data Matrix, PDF417, Aztec, QR).

includeText.title: Show the value under the bars

foreground.title: Bar colour
foreground.description: 6-digit hex colour of the bars, e.g. #000000.

background.title: Background colour
background.description: 6-digit hex colour behind the bars, e.g. #ffffff.

padding.title: Padding (px)
padding.description: Empty space around the barcode (quiet zone).

zip.title: Bundle into one ZIP
zip.description: Also save every file in barcodes.zip (when there is more than one value).
